llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `requestPermission` from `useCameraPermissions()` only from a user-triggered action (for example `Pressable.onPress`), not on initial mount.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: requestPermission is only called from openCameraFlow (triggered by Pressable.onPress 'Open Camera') and retryPermission (triggered by Pressable.onPress 'Retry Permission'). The useEffect on mount only calls refreshPermissionStatus (a read, not a request).
evidence: onPress={() => void openCameraFlow()} -> calls requestPermission inside
onPress={() => void retryPermission()} -> calls requestPermission inside

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must support denied and blocked flows by retrying with `requestPermission` and using `Linking.openSettings()` when `permission.canAskAgain` is false.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: retryPermission re-calls requestPermission when canAskAgain is true; when status==='denied' && !canAskAgain, an 'Open Settings' Pressable calls Linking.openSettings().
evidence: retryPermission: if (!canAskAgain) return; else await requestPermission()
isCameraFlowActive && !isGranted && status === 'denied' && !canAskAgain -> Pressable onPress openSystemSettings -> Linking.openSettings()

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must refresh permission state on app foreground with `AppState.addEventListener('change', ...)` and a permission refresh call (`getPermission` / `getCameraPermissionsAsync`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: AppState.addEventListener('change', ...) is registered in a useEffect; when nextState === 'active', refreshPermissionStatus is called.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render a deterministic fallback `View`/`Text` path when permission is unavailable instead of rendering `CameraView`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When permission is not granted, a fallback View with placeholder Text is rendered instead of CameraView.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must prevent concurrent permission requests by guarding `requestPermission` with an in-flight state (for example `requesting`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: isRequestingPermission guards the UI (hides retry button while requesting) but does not prevent concurrent calls to requestPermission itself. openCameraFlow and retryPermission both call requestPermission without checking isRequestingPermission before invoking, so two concurrent presses could trigger two simultaneous requests.
evidence: retryPermission: no guard on isRequestingPermission before calling requestPermission()
openCameraFlow: no guard on isRequestingPermission before calling requestPermission()
isRequestingPermission is set inside requestPermission but callers do not check it first

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render `CameraView` only when `permission.granted` is true, with deterministic denied/blocked fallback UI otherwise.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: CameraView renders only when isCameraFlowActive && isGranted; all other states render the placeholder View/Text fallback.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement preview with `CameraView` and permission handling with `expo-camera` APIs used by the sample (`useCameraPermissions` with request/get methods, or `getCameraPermissionsAsync`/`requestCameraPermissionsAsync`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: CameraView is imported and used for preview; Camera.getCameraPermissionsAsync and Camera.requestCameraPermissionsAsync from expo-camera are used for permission handling.
